milestone: Native Trash and Windows Recycle Bin qualification
contract: Trash is a separate worker mutation and never falls back to permanent deletion.
The selected row is revalidated by navigation stamp and native object identity before disposition.
Unsupported platforms retain the source and report an explicit adapter observation.
Windows Recycle Bin publication uses a held source handle, no-replace native rename, restore metadata, and post-publication identity verification.

windows_x64_workstation.trash_behavior: Qualified on V:; fixture moved to Recycle Bin, matching $I/$R metadata was verified, and only that pair was cleaned up

remaining_scope: Implement and qualify native macOS Trash.
Implement and qualify mount-aware freedesktop/Linux Trash with restore metadata.
Qualify real Windows cross-volume move behavior, recursive moves, recovery, sanitizer/race gates, and full interactive acceptance.
